333 def _handle_agent_response_and_continue(
334     self: Agent,
335     a2a_result: dict[str, Any],
336     agent_id: str,
337     agent_cards: dict[str, AgentCard] | None,
338     a2a_agents: list[A2AConfig],
339     original_task_description: str,
340     conversation_history: list[Message],
341     turn_num: int,
342     max_turns: int,
343     task: Task,
344     original_fn: Callable[..., str],
345     context: str | None,
346     tools: list[BaseTool] | None,
347     agent_response_model: type[BaseModel],
348 ) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
349     """Handle A2A result and get CrewAI agent's response.
350 
351     Args:
352         self: The agent instance
353         a2a_result: Result from A2A delegation
354         agent_id: ID of the A2A agent
355         agent_cards: Pre-fetched agent cards
356         a2a_agents: List of A2A configurations
357         original_task_description: Original task description
358         conversation_history: Conversation history
359         turn_num: Current turn number
360         max_turns: Maximum turns allowed
361         task: The task being executed
362         original_fn: Original execute_task method
363         context: Optional context
364         tools: Optional tools
365         agent_response_model: Response model for parsing
366 
367     Returns:
368         Tuple of (final_result, current_request) where:
369         - final_result is not None if conversation should end
370         - current_request is the next message to send if continuing
371     """
372     agent_cards_dict = agent_cards or {}
373     if "agent_card" in a2a_result and agent_id not in agent_cards_dict:
374         agent_cards_dict[agent_id] = a2a_result["agent_card"]
375 
376     task.description = _augment_prompt_with_a2a(
377         a2a_agents=a2a_agents,
378         task_description=original_task_description,
379         conversation_history=conversation_history,
380         turn_num=turn_num,
381         max_turns=max_turns,
382         agent_cards=agent_cards_dict,
383     )
384 
385     raw_result = original_fn(self, task, context, tools)
386     llm_response = _parse_agent_response(
387         raw_result=raw_result, agent_response_model=agent_response_model
388     )
389 
390     if isinstance(llm_response, BaseModel) and isinstance(
391         llm_response, AgentResponseProtocol
392     ):
393         if not llm_response.is_a2a:
394             final_turn_number = turn_num + 1
395             crewai_event_bus.emit(
396                 None,
397                 A2AMessageSentEvent(
398                     message=str(llm_response.message),
399                     turn_number=final_turn_number,
400                     is_multiturn=True,
401                     agent_role=self.role,
402                 ),
403             )
404             crewai_event_bus.emit(
405                 None,
406                 A2AConversationCompletedEvent(
407                     status="completed",
408                     final_result=str(llm_response.message),
409                     error=None,
410                     total_turns=final_turn_number,
411                 ),
412             )
413             return str(llm_response.message), None
414         return None, str(llm_response.message)
415 
416     return str(raw_result), None
intended_behavior: Properly handle the "completed" status by returning a non-null final_result and None for next_request when the status is "completed", regardless of the is_a2a flag. This will ensure the multi-turn loop ends appropriately on completion and no further delegation requests are made.

419 def _delegate_to_a2a(
420     self: Agent,
421     agent_response: AgentResponseProtocol,
422     task: Task,
423     original_fn: Callable[..., str],
424     context: str | None,
425     tools: list[BaseTool] | None,
426     agent_cards: dict[str, AgentCard] | None = None,
427     original_task_description: str | None = None,
428 ) -> str:
429     """Delegate to A2A agent with multi-turn conversation support.
430 
431     Args:
432         self: The agent instance
433         agent_response: The AgentResponse indicating delegation
434         task: The task being executed (for extracting A2A fields)
435         original_fn: The original execute_task method for follow-ups
436         context: Optional context for task execution
437         tools: Optional tools available to the agent
438         agent_cards: Pre-fetched agent cards from _execute_task_with_a2a
439         original_task_description: The original task description before A2A augmentation
440 
441     Returns:
442         Result from A2A agent
443 
444     Raises:
445         ImportError: If a2a-sdk is not installed
446     """
447     a2a_agents, agent_response_model = get_a2a_agents_and_response_model(self.a2a)
448     agent_ids = tuple(config.endpoint for config in a2a_agents)
449     current_request = str(agent_response.message)
450     agent_id = agent_response.a2a_ids[0]
451 
452     if agent_id not in agent_ids:
453         raise ValueError(
454             f"Unknown A2A agent ID(s): {agent_response.a2a_ids} not in {agent_ids}"
455         )
456 
457     agent_config = next(filter(lambda x: x.endpoint == agent_id, a2a_agents))
458     task_config = task.config or {}
459     context_id = task_config.get("context_id")
460     task_id_config = task_config.get("task_id")
461     reference_task_ids = task_config.get("reference_task_ids")
462     metadata = task_config.get("metadata")
463     extensions = task_config.get("extensions")
464 
465     if original_task_description is None:
466         original_task_description = task.description
467 
468     conversation_history: list[Message] = []
469     max_turns = agent_config.max_turns
470 
471     try:
472         for turn_num in range(max_turns):
473             console_formatter = getattr(crewai_event_bus, "_console", None)
474             agent_branch = None
475             if console_formatter:
476                 agent_branch = getattr(
477                     console_formatter, "current_agent_branch", None
478                 ) or getattr(console_formatter, "current_task_branch", None)
479 
480             a2a_result = execute_a2a_delegation(
481                 endpoint=agent_config.endpoint,
482                 auth=agent_config.auth,
483                 timeout=agent_config.timeout,
484                 task_description=current_request,
485                 context_id=context_id,
486                 task_id=task_id_config,
487                 reference_task_ids=reference_task_ids,
488                 metadata=metadata,
489                 extensions=extensions,
490                 conversation_history=conversation_history,
491                 agent_id=agent_id,
492                 agent_role=Role.user,
493                 agent_branch=agent_branch,
494                 response_model=agent_config.response_model,
495                 turn_number=turn_num + 1,
496             )
497 
498             conversation_history = a2a_result.get("history", [])
499 
500             if a2a_result["status"] in ["completed", "input_required"]:
501                 final_result, next_request = _handle_agent_response_and_continue(
502                     self=self,
503                     a2a_result=a2a_result,
504                     agent_id=agent_id,
505                     agent_cards=agent_cards,
506                     a2a_agents=a2a_agents,
507                     original_task_description=original_task_description,
508                     conversation_history=conversation_history,
509                     turn_num=turn_num,
510                     max_turns=max_turns,
511                     task=task,
512                     original_fn=original_fn,
513                     context=context,
514                     tools=tools,
515                     agent_response_model=agent_response_model,
516                 )
517 
518                 if final_result is not None:
519                     return final_result
520 
521                 if next_request is not None:
522                     current_request = next_request
523 
524                 continue
525 
526             error_msg = a2a_result.get("error", "Unknown error")
527             crewai_event_bus.emit(
528                 None,
529                 A2AConversationCompletedEvent(
530                     status="failed",
531                     final_result=None,
532                     error=error_msg,
533                     total_turns=turn_num + 1,
534                 ),
535             )
536             raise Exception(f"A2A delegation failed: {error_msg}")
537 
538         if conversation_history:
539             for msg in reversed(conversation_history):
540                 if msg.role == Role.agent:
541                     text_parts = [
542                         part.root.text for part in msg.parts if part.root.kind == "text"
543                     ]
544                     final_message = (
545                         " ".join(text_parts) if text_parts else "Conversation completed"
546                     )
547                     crewai_event_bus.emit(
548                         None,
549                         A2AConversationCompletedEvent(
550                             status="completed",
551                             final_result=final_message,
552                             error=None,
553                             total_turns=max_turns,
554                         ),
555                     )
556                     return final_message
557 
558         crewai_event_bus.emit(
559             None,
560             A2AConversationCompletedEvent(
561                 status="failed",
562                 final_result=None,
563                 error=f"Conversation exceeded maximum turns ({max_turns})",
564                 total_turns=max_turns,
565             ),
566         )
567         raise Exception(f"A2A conversation exceeded maximum turns ({max_turns})")
568 
569     finally:
570         task.description = original_task_description
intended_behavior: Immediately return final_result when it is not None, and avoid sending further delegation requests after receiving a "completed" status. The loop should only continue when the status is "input_required" or another ongoing state, preserving multi-turn behavior but correctly breaking on completion.
